title: Man killed during a shootout in Markdale is identified
article: Ontario's Special Investigations Unit has released the name of a man who died during a shootout in Markdale.
The SIU says 24-year-old Darren Burnside of Holland Centre was shot when officers tried to intercept the tractor he was allegedly ramming into police cruisers on Monday.
Police were first called to the scene to respond to reports of a man shooting at a home in the area.
